change: Reliability PR 9's gates (docs/plans/reliability/9-korean.md, v1, Gates), selected by the repository owner in the blueprint: no required negation or literal lost, integrity, and paired recall and coverage lower bounds of -0.05 against the same run's English control. A later change is a new version before its measurement.
description: Read by `tool/eval/report.py` for a `compare.py --experiment pairs` run (`tool/eval/korean.py`). Every paired gate reads the frozen cohort: every pair in all four arms at repetition 0. A missing row, or a coverage grade still missing after one regrade, leaves a paired gate inconclusive; a failed retrieval scores recall 0 and a failed answer coverage 0. A question or fact unit not normalized leaves Literals inconclusive; a verified answer without a grade leaves Integrity inconclusive.

gates.label: No required negation or literal lost (questions B, D; twin fact units)
No fabricated accepted citation, and no verified answer with an unsupported claim
Paired evidence recall, B-A, C-A and D-A: lower end at least
Paired answer coverage, B-A, C-A and D-A: lower end at least
